title: Marèva & Marèva 2
description: An exclusive collection of grand 4, 5, and 6-bedroom multi-level standalone villas. Characterized by modern architecture with vast windows framing water views, these ultra-luxury properties offer built-up areas exceeding 7,200 sq. ft.

title: Ostra Palace Villas
description: Elegant, classical-inspired luxury villas offering timeless architectural charm. These multi-bedroom homes blend classic European aesthetics with modern open-plan living, set for completion in late 2029.

title: Lavita at The Oasis
description: The crown jewel of The Oasis, featuring ultra-premium mansions starting at AED 36 Million. Designed for high-net-worth buyers, this enclave features massive plots and custom interior layouts.

title: Tierra Address Villas
description: Branded by Address Hotels + Resorts, these 6-bedroom expansive villas offer five-star hospitality services integrated into private residential living, complete with refined interior finishes.

title: Palmiera Villas
description: A highly successful series of 4 and 5-bedroom luxury villas starting from AED 8.5M. They offer a balance of modern geometric design, private gardens, and seamless access to central waterways.

title: Mirage at The Oasis
description: A premium cluster of expansive villas starting at AED 15.8M. Built on larger plots, these homes feature multiple private lounges, grand entryways, and serene waterfront positioning.

title: Valoria at The Oasis
description: One of the newest additions to the masterplan, featuring premium standalone villas slated for a Q4 2029 handover surrounded by serene water features.

title: Salva Townhouses
description: A family-focused neighborhood offering spacious 3 and 4-bedroom modern townhouses starting from AED 2.5M. Bright interiors and private outdoor spaces flow into green corridors.

title: Serro & Serro 2
description: Premium residential clusters offering semi-detached villas and townhouses with smart-home technology and direct access to 38km cycling tracks and wellness centers.

title: Emaar Fior (1 & 2)
description: Low-rise, contemporary waterfront apartment buildings offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom layouts. Direct access to a chic promenade, a world-class yacht club, and sunken seating areas.

title: Sera (1 & 2)
description: Twin-tower and townhouse complexes blending coastal luxury with urban convenience. Featuring a mix of apartments and ground-level townhouses.

title: Aurea by Emaar
description: Waterfront residential block offering panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline, featuring resort-style pools and marine leisure facilities.

title: Baystar by Vida
description: Branded by Vida Hotels and Resorts, this development offers chic, youthful, and artistic waterfront apartments designed for modern professionals.

title: Creek Bay
description: A twin-tower waterfront development offering premium apartments starting at AED 1.8M with podium-level amenities and direct access to Creek Marina.

title: Creek Haven
description: Sleek dual towers (Tower A & B) offering bright, open-plan apartments with sweeping views of the Creek and wildlife sanctuary.

title: Lyvia by Palace
description: A branded residence bringing five-star Palace Hotels luxury to Creek Island with hotel-grade amenities and bespoke interior design.

title: Valia at Dubai Creek
description: Latest high-rise addition to the Creek skyline focusing on sustainable living and panoramic balcony views toward Downtown Dubai.

title: Albero by Emaar
description: Family-friendly apartment complex starting at AED 1.81M, nestled in a quieter district of the Creek within walking distance of retail promenades.

title: Grand Polo - Equiterra
description: Premium 3-story townhouses and bespoke villas built around championship polo fields, equestrian centers, and expansive green parks.

title: Grand Polo - Selvara
description: Sister community to Equiterra offering high-end townhouses with private gardens integrated with polo club retail and leisure infrastructure.

title: Palace Residences Hillside A
description: Fully furnished 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and townhouses branded by Palace Hotels sitting directly on Dubai Hills Park.

title: Rosehill (Blocks A, B & C)
description: Multi-block residential enclave for urban families with contemporary apartments, podium gardens, pool decks, and co-working spaces.

title: Terra Woods (Bldg 1, 2 & 3)
description: Eco-conscious mid-rise development offering apartments and townhouses starting from AED 1.6M with natural wood facades and lush greenery.

title: Terra Gardens (Bldg 1 & 2)
description: Sister project to Terra Woods focusing heavily on landscaped podium gardens, sustainable building materials, and active outdoor plazas.

title: Golf Trails & Golf Fields
description: Dedicated sub-communities bordering the Emaar South golf course offering premium townhouses and apartments near Al Maktoum Airport.

title: DAMAC Islands & Islands 2
description: A viral tropical-themed mega-community featuring island-inspired clusters, massive swimmable lagoons, and high-end waterfront homes.

title: DAMAC Riverside
description: Luxury master community focusing on resort-style riverside living, featuring premium apartments, townhouses, and floating amenity hubs.

title: Volta & Casa Towers
description: Ultra-luxury high-rise towers (Volta on SZR and Casa in Al Sufouh) offering premium sky suites and penthouses with Golden Visa eligibility.

title: Utopia & Violet 4
description: High-end resort villa and townhouse additions expanding the massive DAMAC Hills and DAMAC Hills 2 master communities.

title: Sobha Siniya Island
description: Exclusive island masterplan offering resort-style waterfront mansions and villas surrounded by untouched natural beauty and beaches.

title: Sobha Hartland II
description: Flagship MBR City masterplan featuring waterfront villas and luxury apartments set among green boulevards and lagoons.

title: The Greens at Sobha Sanctuary
description: Recently launched sub-community emphasizing wellness, open green spaces, and contemporary architectural layouts.

title: Palm Jebel Ali
description: The ongoing rollout of ultra-luxury frond villas and waterfront plots on Dubai's highly anticipated second palm island.

title: Como Residences
description: A visually striking, ultra-luxury high-rise on Palm Jumeirah offering massive layouts, panoramic sea views, and absolute exclusivity.

title: Palm Beach Tower 2
description: High-value address on Palm Jumeirah providing beachfront living, resort-style amenities, private beach access, and strong rental appeal.

title: Jumeirah Living Business Bay
description: High-end branded residence offering hotel-style service, larger layouts, and a prime position near the Dubai Canal and Downtown Dubai.

title: Ela by Omniyat
description: Newly launched ultra-luxury residential project on Palm Jumeirah focusing on bespoke architecture, elite exclusivity, and massive floor plans.

title: Arancia Yards & Passo
description: Newly introduced premium developments under Omniyat's 'Beyond' brand, catering to buyers looking for architectural distinction.

title: Everly Place
description: Boutique residential project reflecting Ellington's signature focus on high-quality interiors, functional layouts, and premium common areas.
